evidence.title: About mesh3d - The Three.js & 3D Website Gallery

name: mesh3d
summary: Curated gallery of Three.js, WebGL and interactive 3D websites, with maker profiles and a weekly render newsletter.
description: A human-curated gallery of production websites and creative-coding experiments built with Three.js, WebGL, Spline and related real-time 3D tooling. The directory lists 434 websites and 118 experiments from 287 makers, browsable by tag, technology and studio; each entry links out to the live site and credits its makers. Makers get profile pages, the blog runs studio interviews, and a weekly 'render' newsletter picks six Three.js sites. For designers, developers and creative directors looking for 3D web inspiration.
contains: filter by tag, technology and maker
technologies covered: Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Spline, Rive, Babylon.js, GSAP, Lenis, Lottie, OGL, p5.js
top makers: PeachWeb 26 entries, Unseen Studio 24, Anderson Mancini 15
weekly 'render' newsletter with six hand-picked Three.js sites
